title: Crumb Cake

items.item: unsalted butter, melted (3 sticks; changed to 1 ½ sticks)

instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking pan. Lightly dust pan with flour; shake out any excess flour.
Cake: Combine cake mix, sour cream, oil, eggs, cinnamon and nutmeg in a large bowl. Beat according to package directions. Pour batter into the prepared pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 20 min or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Topping: Blend flour, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and melted butter in medium bowl until mixture is evenly moistened and clumps together.
Remove cake from the oven. Sprinkle with crumbs (this will be a thick layer). Return to oven; bake 15 minutes or until crumbs are slightly set. Remove pan to wire rack and let cool completely.
